dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Good morning. May I see your passport and booking confirmation, please?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Thank you, Mr Seilov. Are you checking in any bags today, or just carry-on luggage?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Just one bag to check in. It's 18 kilograms.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: That's within the allowance — 23 kilograms is the limit. Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: A window seat, please. I've never flown before — I want to see the view.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Of course! Here's your boarding pass. Your gate is B12. Boarding begins at 09:40.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Straight ahead and then follow the signs. Please make sure all liquids are in containers under 100ml.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I have a bottle of water — will that be a problem?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: You'll need to finish it or throw it away before security. You can buy water after you pass through.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: OK. What about my laptop? Do I need to take it out?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Yes — remove your laptop and place it separately in the tray. Also remove your belt and jacket.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Got it. And what time does my flight depart?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Your flight to Almaty departs at 10:15. The gate closes at 10:00 — please be there at least 20 minutes early.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I will. Thank you very much.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Have a wonderful flight, Mr Seilov. Enjoy Almaty!
